signals.problem: HR/admin staff must manually repeat the same actions across multiple disconnected Saudi government portals (Qiwa, Mudad, GOSI, Muqeem) for every employee event: contract updates, iqama/visa renewals, GOSI registration, salary certification uploads, status changes. Each platform has its own login and workflow, so the same employee data is re-entered several times.
signals.customer: HR/Admin coordinators and outsourced HR-services firms at SMEs (10–300 employees) across all sectors that employ non-Saudi staff
signals.source: Job boards (Bayt, Glassdoor) + HR compliance guide (payrollmiddleeast.com)

evidence.claim: HR Coordinators in Saudi Arabia are explicitly hired to process actions across Qiwa, Muqeem, GOSI and Mudad — updating contracts, renewing employee info, issuing visas, handling status changes, and managing Iqama/work-permit renewals.
evidence.source_title: Qiwa Saudi Arabia: Employer Guide for Payroll, HR and Labour Compliance
evidence.summary: Per search snippet: article describes HR coordinators executing repetitive company procedures on Qiwa/Mudad/GOSI/Muqeem including contract updates, visa issuance, residency and license renewals.

evidence.claim: Multiple active job postings for 'HR Officer – GOSI & HRDF' and 'HR Coordinator' roles exist in Saudi Arabia specifically naming these portals as core duties.
evidence.source_title: HR Officer – Gosi & Hrdf Jobs in Saudi Arabia (Jul 2026) - Bayt.com
evidence.summary: Per search snippet: Bayt.com lists dedicated openings for GOSI/HRDF-focused HR officer roles, indicating recurring demand for this manual compliance work.

existing_solution.name: Mudad
existing_solution.notes: Official payroll/WPS platform, one of the several portals staff must juggle; does not unify Qiwa/GOSI/Muqeem workflows

signals.workaround: Companies hire dedicated HR coordinators (or outsource to HR/PRO agencies) who log into each portal manually and re-key employee data
signals.potential_solution: A lightweight SaaS that centralizes employee record data and generates/tracks the required Qiwa/Mudad/GOSI/Muqeem actions with reminders and pre-filled forms (RPA-assisted where portals allow), reducing duplicate data entry
signals.business_model: B2B SaaS subscription per employee/month, sold to SMEs and HR outsourcing firms
signals.existing_spend: NO RELIABLE EVIDENCE FOUND (no public salary figure captured for this exact role in this session; job exists as a dedicated hire per Bayt listing)
unknowns: Whether Qiwa/GOSI/Muqeem allow any automated/API access without violating ToS
Actual salary cost of HR coordinator role for this specific compliance task
Willingness of SMEs to pay for a third-party tool touching government logins
